def solve(g):
    g = np.array(g)
    n = g.shape[0]
    # find distinct diagonals d=r-c that contain nonzero cells
    ds = sorted({(r-c) for r in range(n) for c in range(n) if g[r,c]!=0})
    # colors per d
    col = {}
    for r in range(n):
        for c in range(n):
            if g[r,c]!=0:
                d = r-c
                if d in col: assert col[d]==g[r,c]
                col[d]=g[r,c]
    # smallest period p with distinct residues and consistent colors
    for p in range(1, 2*n+1):
        m = {}
        ok = True
        for d,c in col.items():
            k = d % p
            if k in m and m[k]!=c: ok=False; break
            m[k]=c
        if ok and len(m)==len(ds):
            out = np.zeros_like(g)
            for r in range(n):
                for c in range(n):
                    out[r,c] = m[(r-c)%p]
            return out
    return None
